id: title:ReeceJones:make default test user organization owner

review.posthog_relevance: Changes account ownership role assignment and adds regression tests for Matrix account provisioning, potentially affecting permission boundaries and account ownership semantics.
review.reason: Replaces account membership level from ADMIN to OWNER when saving account, adds necessary model import, and includes a regression test asserting the new OWNER level. This is a substantive, bounded change with implementation and checks visible, warranting a score of 2. The connection to PostHog is established through account ownership and permission boundaries.
review.uncertainty: The exact operational impact of changing the role from ADMIN to OWNER is not demonstrated by the code alone; this could be a minor permission adjustment or a significant change. No release notes or adoption metrics are available. The score is assigned based on the presence of implementation and tests, not the unverified outcome.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
